item.tib: bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs bcud de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo zhes bya ba'i gzungs
item.coloph: zhes pa 'di yangabla chen dran pa dngos su byonapa/ snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa dbyil ston dpon gsas khyung rgodartsal gyis gter lugs zhal bzang nas thon pa'i gdugs dkar gyi sgrub skor las gzungs sngags ma byon par/ gter snyan rgyud gzhan nas 'byung bar dgongs yin 'dug gshis/ snyigs dus sprul sku bye ba phrag brgya'i nang tshan mngon par 'phags pa'i skyes bu sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i snyan rgyud mdzad mdo rgyas pa las byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo rigs sngags rgyal mo'i gzungs sgrub 'di ltar zur phyung du bsgrigs pa ni sgo rigs nyi ri shel zhin gyis sbyar ba dge bar gyur cig/
